items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I don't know why I want to say Charlie, but I don't know -- I'm not sure what it was.

ctx.x: Do you remember Mr. White's first name?

I can't remember it. I don't know why I want to say Charlie, but I don't know -- I'm not sure what it was. But anyway, -- and then the xylophones I taught myself, because I bought them and took them home and put them up in Lee's room, and I used to practice 3 or 4 hours a day. And

that's not hard to teach, you know, the methods. You're already a musician, and I already knew the keyboard to the piano, and you get the method and then what you have to do is practice running scales and practice reading. It's not that hard once you've been in to it.
